about.title: About CYNA
about.article: CYNA is an educational cybersecurity marketplace designed and developed by a team of four Bachelor students at Institut Limayrac in Toulouse.
about.article2: The project demonstrates a modern e-commerce journey for discovering cybersecurity software, managing a cart, purchasing licences through Stripe, and following orders and subscriptions from a customer account.
about.article3: CYNA is a school prototype, not a cybersecurity company or a production security platform. The products and business information shown are demonstration content and no SOC, EDR, XDR, monitoring or security service is actually operated by the student team.

faq.title: Help
faq.subtitle: Find a quick answer below, or open a ticket with our team.
faq.contactIntro: For a question about the marketplace, its billing demo or a support request, contact the student team.
faq.schoolDisclaimer: CYNA is a student project developed at Institut Limayrac. The institute does not operate or endorse this marketplace as a commercial cybersecurity service.

items.a: CYNA is a marketplace that lets businesses buy and manage cybersecurity SaaS licences (SOC, EDR, XDR, firewalls and more) in just a few clicks.

items.q: How do I subscribe to a product?
items.a: Browse the catalog, open a product page, choose your billing plan (monthly or annual), then add it to your cart to complete your order.

items.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Payments are processed securely and encrypted through Stripe. You can pay by credit or debit card.

items.q: Can I manage my subscriptions from my account?
items.a: Yes. Once logged in, you can find your order history and the status of your subscriptions in your personal dashboard.

items.q: How can I get help quickly?
items.a: Chat with our CynAI assistant at the bottom-right of the screen, or fill in the form below and a member of our team will get back to you by email.

legal.legal_paragraph: CYNA is an educational prototype. This page identifies the student project, its contact channel and the third-party services used for the demonstration.
legal.projectStatus: Educational project, not a commercial company
legal.hosting_paragraph: The demonstration uses third-party hosting and cloud services. No claim is made that the application or its data are hosted exclusively in France or meet production cybersecurity certification requirements.
legal.hostingValue: Next.js application with Supabase and Stripe demonstration services
legal.intelprop_paragraph1: The application source code and original project content were produced for an educational assignment by the student team.
legal.intelprop_paragraph2: Third-party names, product examples, libraries and services remain the property of their respective owners. Their presence does not imply a commercial partnership.
legal.intelprop_paragraph3: The catalog is fictional demonstration content and does not grant licences to real cybersecurity products.
legal.privacy_paragraph1: CYNA limits collection to the personal data needed to operate accounts, orders and support. Data should not be kept merely for convenience when less precise or anonymous information is sufficient.
legal.privacy_paragraph2: To request access to your personal data, open a ticket and select “Personal data access request”. Proportionate identity verification may be required. Never send your password, an MFA code or card details in a ticket.
legal.payment_security_paragraph: The full card number and security code are entered directly in Stripe Checkout and are not stored by CYNA. PCI DSS governs the protection of card data. Stripe states that it is a PCI DSS Level 1 certified service provider; this certification does not automatically extend to CYNA, which remains responsible for securing its integration.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.paragraph1: These terms describe the use of CYNA, an educational marketplace prototype intended for demonstration and assessment, not for the commercial delivery of cybersecurity services.
terms.subtitle2: Access to SaaS Services and Account Creation
terms.paragraph2: A demonstration account is required for order history, invoices and subscriptions. Users should not enter sensitive or production data and remain responsible for their test credentials.
terms.paragraph3: Original project code and content were created by the student team. Third-party names, libraries and example products remain the property of their respective owners.
terms.paragraph4: Payments use Stripe test mode. Displayed prices, orders, invoices and renewals do not represent commercial offers or real cybersecurity licences.
terms.paragraph5: Availability is not guaranteed. The student team may suspend or reset the prototype, chatbot, catalog and test data for maintenance or demonstrations.
terms.paragraph6: CYNA must not be relied on to protect systems, monitor threats or provide professional advice. It has no production security infrastructure or service-level agreement.
terms.subtitle7: Modifications to Terms and Applicable Law
terms.paragraph7: These notices may change as the school project evolves. Questions can be sent to support.cyna@gmail.com.
